question: Olympian boxer Vijender Singh belongs to which of the following states?
solution:

• Vijender Singh has represented India in the Olympics for a total of three times.

• Olympics Overview

 
 
• The Olympics are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The modern Olympic Games were first held in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
 
• The Olympics are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is responsible for organizing the Games and overseeing the host city's preparations.
 
 
 
• Vijender Singh's Achievements
 
 
• Vijender Singh Beniwal, born on October 29, 1985, is an Indian professional boxer and former amateur boxer.
 
• He won a bronze medal in the middleweight category at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, making him the first Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal.
 
• Vijender has also won medals at the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games, adding to his impressive list of achievements.
 
• He turned professional in 2015 and has since continued to make a mark in the professional boxing circuit.
 
 
 
• Boxing in the Olympics
 
 
• Boxing has been a part of the Olympic Games since its inclusion in the 1904 St. Louis Games.
 
• The competition is divided into different weight categories, and boxers compete in a knockout format to win medals.
 
• Olympic boxing matches are typically shorter than professional bouts, consisting of three three-minute rounds.
 
• The scoring system is based on the number of clean punches landed, and judges decide the winner if there is no knockout.
